args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 it must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: `ROUND_HALF_UP` → `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (matches the existing docstring and FIN-212 requirement).

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha 08d3cd5986): **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py` half-even cases (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).
